_comment: Touge Nights' part shops (see docs/modding.md, "partshops"): the makes' specialists, a tuning house, a junkyard
and a machine shop. Pins on the dealers' map.

shops.name: Toyota Sport Parts Gunma
shops.blurb: The dealer's parts counter, with the TRD catalogue under the glass for anyone who asks.

shops.name: Nissan Prince Parts
shops.blurb: Skyline people. They have the RB's parts book by heart and will tell you so.

shops.name: Speed Factory K
shops.blurb: Turbines on the wall, a dyno in the back, and a waiting list. Mr. K builds what wins on the pass.

shops.name: Akagi Salvage
shops.blurb: Where the pass's losers end up. Engines by the pallet, if you can find one that isn't bent.

shops.name: Ono Engineering
shops.blurb: Blocks bored, heads ported, cranks balanced. Old Ono doesn't talk much, but his engines rev.
